definitions.explanation: A species of animal or plant that has long lived in an area, as opposed to one brought in from elsewhere. Also used of traditional local crop and livestock varieties.

examples.japanese: {在来種|ざいらいしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
⟦{外来種|がいらいしゅ}→外来種：23243_gairaishu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{在来種|ざいらいしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}い{出|だ}している→追い出す：04625_oidasu⟧。
examples.english: Introduced species are driving out the native ones.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{在来種|ざいらいしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大豆|だいず}→大豆：10536_daizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}って→減る：01985_heru⟧きて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: In this region, fewer and fewer farmers grow the local traditional variety of soybean.

notes:
{在来|ざいらい} (existing, long-established) + 〜⟦{種|しゅ}→種：28584_shu⟧ (species, variety).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{外来種|がいらいしゅ}→外来種：23243_gairaishu⟧: introduced species; often an invasive one
- {固有種|こゆうしゅ}: endemic species; found only in that place, a narrower term
- {在来|ざいらい}⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧: conventional railway line (as opposed to the Shinkansen), the same {在来|ざいらい}
